description: 5 entries over 14 days — tests economy and selection

entries.text: Woke up early before everyone else. Made coffee and sat by the window for a while. The street was quiet. I keep thinking about the agent registry project — whether the abstraction is right or whether we are building something too clever for its own good.

Had dinner with Rathna tonight. She cooked kozhukattai — it turned out perfectly, better than last time. We talked about her work and what the next year might look like for both of us. Felt warm and grounded after.

Long meeting with the team. Demoed the knowledge graph feature. People seemed genuinely impressed but I am not sure they understand what it took to get here. The hybrid retrieval idea was the key — once that clicked everything else followed.
Photo taken at the hiking trail near the reservoir. Clear morning, light through the trees. Went alone — needed the silence.
Finished reading The Idea Factory tonight. Bell Labs feels like a different world — a time when institutions had the patience to let ideas breathe. I wonder if anything like that is possible now.
